drums.tags: Bossa nova. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated bossa nova chords with a steady thumb-plucked bassline on beats 1 and 3. A shaker maintains a consistent sixteenth-note pattern. The percussion features a woodblock or rimshot playing a 3-2 son clave pattern. A melodic flute enters with legato phrasing and light vibrato. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The key is G major. The arrangement is sparse with a dry mix and minimal reverb.

bass.tags: Acoustic folk percussion track. The arrangement consists of a dry, close-miked acoustic guitar and a layered percussion section. The acoustic guitar performs a repetitive, syncopated fingerstyle pattern using palm-muted bass notes and sharp treble snaps. Percussion includes a wooden stomp box on beats one and three, accompanied by handclaps and a metallic tambourine jingle on the backbeats. A shaker maintains a steady sixteenth-note subdivision. The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The recording features minimal room reverb, emphasizing a dry, intimate studio aesthetic. The guitar follows a percussive slap-and-pluck technique where the strings are struck against the frets to create a rhythmic click.
